controlGate.note: The label text differs by docs/sr1-decisions.md decision 2 (Segoe UI vs SF); a labelled checkbox keeps its box at the Mac position relative to the label (leading edge), and AppKit sets a labelled box 0.8 pt low, so y is allowed 2 px of play for the line-height difference between the fonts. The box itself must match exactly with edge-aa<=32.
controlGate.labelCentreToleranceReason: measured: the label's vertical centre differs by 0.5 px on every run (Segoe UI Variable Text 13 DIP (G70) vs SF 13 pt, decision 2); was 3 px
controlGate.controlGapToleranceReason: H34 side bearing: the label's first ink is 1 px later on Windows, so the box-to-label gap measures 15 px Windows against 14 px Mac; the checkbox gap takes the one-sided range [0, 1]
